Popcorn Snacks
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 4:11am

Ingredients




3 cups Popped Corn
3 cups = one serving

Preparation

1 For a TV snack, or something to take to the show or the ball game that stays fresh and crisp, try seasoned popcorn. 2 Pop corn without fat using directions on popper and season to taste with any of the following:Butter Flavored Salt Taco Seasoning Garlic Salt Onion Salt Parmeson Cheese Dried Herbs Hickory Flavored Salt (Great outdoors) Seasoned Salt 3 * To share with your feathered friends:String left-over popcorn and hang outside for a healthy treat for thebirds. It's fun to watch them eat! In the bleak winter months the birds would love a bit of bacon fat rubbed on the left-over corn. 4 Approved by the American Diabetes Assoc.
